mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investments, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.25% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a month indicates a weakening labor market, which leads to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE increased by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth for two consecutive quarters signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where GDPC1 shows a sustained decline over two consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production index by more than 1% in a month signals a strengthening supply side, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO increased by more than 1% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls by more than 100,000 in a month signals a weakening labor market, which leads to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where PAYEMS decreased by more than 100,000 in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in housing starts and real personal consumption expenditures signals a strengthening demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both increase > 1% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where both HOUST and RSAFS increased by more than 1% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the consumer price index for two consecutive months signals inflationary pressure, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where CPIAUCSL shows a sustained increase over two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts coupled with a decrease in real personal consumption expenditures signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decrease > 1% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decreased by more than 1% in a month.
